description: The Sankey Chart is a variation of a table that displays data in a web/ribboned layout. The chart consists of nodes, representing categories, and links between nodes representing the shared data between the two categories. Each link in the Sankey Chart would represents one row in a table, and its width corresponds to the value of that data point. The nodes are positioned as the links demand. The Sankey Chart is particularly useful when comparing relationships between categories. It allows users for easy identification of the highest or lowest values and enables users to quickly discern patterns or trends within the dataset. Sankey Chart offers customization options for multiple visual aspects.
